qso/repeat_sparse.scope: Identical frozen source/r/SDSS detections and unchanged C0/W0. A r; B adds all other-band measurements on nights without NSC r; C adds other bands on original r nights. B1 uses the first physical exposure on each new night, not a result-selected exposure. Seasons use the C union and 90day gaps. Time information/leverage is conditional diagonal W0 information, not proof of independent nightly errors. Full reference 4x4 covariance retained. Formal-error pass counts describe this fixed QSO sample, not catalogue yield.
qso/repeat_sparse.season_split: S adds only NSC visits in actual NSC observing seasons without any r detection; seasons are common to all arms (90-day gap, C union). B minus S adds new nights inside r-covered seasons; C minus B adds visits on r nights.

year/repeat_sparse.scope: Whole held year removed before original blind association. Same frozen r-existing objects and same C0-gated physical held measurements for every model; no held target tunes coefficients. Conditional fixed-match prediction, not rerun matching or absolute PM truth. B1 separates new-night first positions from additional new-night centroids. Shared train-held reference covariance retained.
